sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which feature in a digital word processor is used to send a customized layout letter or invitation to multiple recipients simultaneously without rewriting the text?
In the context of keyboarding skills, which set of keys represents the 'Home Row' for the left hand on a standard QWERTY keyboard?
What does the acronym ITeS stand for in the business and technology sector?
Which of the following keyboard shortcuts is used to 'Undo' the last action performed in a digital documentation software?
State whether True or False: For proper typing ergonomics, the computer monitor should be positioned exactly at or slightly below eye level.
Which keys are traditionally known as the 'Guide Keys' for touch typists on a standard keyboard?
In the ITeS industry, BPO is a common business model. What does BPO mean?
Which text alignment option distributes the text evenly between both the left and right margins of a document?
Which tool in a word processor allows you to copy formatting from one piece of text and apply it directly to another?
State whether True or False: The numeric keypad on the right side of a standard keyboard can only type numbers if the 'Caps Lock' key is activated.
Define ITeS and provide one real-world business example where these services are heavily utilized. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: ITeS stands for Information Technology enabled Services. It involves using IT to improve business processes. Examples include customer support call centers, payroll processing, and medical transcription services.

questions.question_text: What is the significance of the tactile bumps found on the 'Guide Keys' in touch typing? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The tactile bumps on the 'F' and 'J' guide keys help typists physically locate the home row without looking down at the keyboard, ensuring proper initial finger placement.

questions.question_text: Differentiate between the 'Save' and 'Save As' commands when working on digital documentation. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The 'Save' command updates the current document with the latest changes. 'Save As' allows the user to save a new copy of the document with a different file name or location.

questions.question_text: Mention two specific health and productivity benefits of maintaining proper typing ergonomics at a workstation. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Proper typing ergonomics reduces physical strain, preventing repetitive strain injuries like carpal tunnel syndrome, and minimizes back, neck, and eye fatigue during prolonged computer sessions.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of utilizing the 'Find and Replace' feature in a word processor? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: It allows users to quickly search for a specific word or phrase throughout a document and automatically replace it with new text, saving significant manual editing time.

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of 'Styles' in digital documentation and describe how it benefits overall document formatting. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: A Style is a predefined set of formatting choices, such as font, size, and color. Applying styles ensures visual consistency across document headings and allows for rapid, simultaneous formatting updates throughout the entire text layout.

questions.question_text: Describe the primary function of Business Process Management (BPM) within the modern IT and ITeS industry. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: BPM involves analyzing, designing, and optimizing a company's internal business processes using IT solutions. It helps organizations streamline operations, reduce overall costs, improve customer service quality, and increase daily efficiency in delivering core services.

questions.question_text: A school clerk needs to send a personalized fee reminder letter to 500 parents. Explain the specific digital documentation feature she should use, and outline the basic steps to accomplish this task efficiently. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: She should use the Mail Merge feature. This powerful tool involves creating a main text document and linking it to an external data source, like a spreadsheet containing parent details. By inserting specific merge fields and executing the merge, she automatically generates 500 perfectly personalized letters, saving hours of manual retyping.

questions.question_text: A data entry operator works 8-hour shifts but is experiencing severe neck pain and wrist fatigue. Analyze his situation and recommend four specific ergonomic keyboarding practices he must adopt to resolve these health issues. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The operator is suffering due to poor posture and repetitive strain. He must adopt strict ergonomic practices: keep the monitor exactly at eye level to prevent neck strain, place both feet flat on the floor, keep his wrists straight and hovering rather than resting on the desk, and take regular short screen breaks.
